title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets
scientific_focus: Gaseous combustion; flame pyrometry and soot-formation models
objectives: Quantify soot temperatures, soot volume fractions, and the impact of radiation and reaction-model assumptions on computed coflow diffusion flames.
approach: Decode Nikon NEF images from SPICE into color channels, use color-ratio pyrometry and calibrated luminosity to derive soot temperature and concentration fields. Implement coupled flow, species, and soot simulations including radiation reabsorption and sectional aggregate formation; compare Yale and ACME burner cases in normal and reduced gravity.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
